# Raah/Balad test fixtures

These files are **synthetic mock-server fixtures**, not live captures from
Raah.ir or Balad.ir. They contain only field shapes accessed by the legacy
JavaScript and current Go adapter. `fixture-token-1` is deliberately fake and
must never be used against a live provider.

The repository does not contain an authorized, sanitized live provider capture.
Obtain real responses only in an authorized environment, then sanitize them
before adding any captured fixture.
